review_candidates.title: Video / Film Development & Operations Manager
review_candidates.description: Studio Shubz is a media and production powerhouse integrating film and video production, photography, audio production, talent development, creative technology and original intellectual property. We are building our founding operational leadership team and seeking an experienced Video / Film Development & Operations Manager to lead the growth, productivity and commercial performance of our Video / Film Department. ROLE SUMMARY This is not a purely administrative position. The successful candidate must be both a capable operations leader and a working video or film professional who understands production from concept development through delivery. The manager will be responsible for making the department operate, produce, sell, grow, document and deliver consistently. The role combines creative production, project management, business development, team leadership, quality control and revenue accountability. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Lead the daily operations of the Studio Shubz Video / Film Department. • Plan and supervise commercial films, brand films, music videos, wedding films, documentaries, event productions, livestreams and original Studio Shubz content. • Translate creative briefs into practical production plans, schedules, budgets, crew requirements and deliverables. • Participate directly in production where professional expertise is required. • Coordinate cinematographers, camera operators, directors, editors, production assistants and other crew members. • Recruit, onboard, schedule and develop reliable production talent. • Establish efficient workflows for pre-production, production, post-production, review, delivery and archiving. • Maintain production quality, technical standards, deadlines and client expectations. • Develop services and production packages that generate sustainable department revenue. • Support client acquisition, proposals, quotations, negotiations and production presentations. • Track projects, expenses, deliverables, equipment use and department performance. • Ensure that footage, project files, releases, licences, contracts and production records are properly documented and archived. • Identify opportunities for original films, series, digital programmes and other intellectual property. • Collaborate with the Audio and Photography Development & Operations Managers on integrated productions. • Report progress, risks, revenue activity and operational requirements to the Founder / Executive Creative Leadership. REQUIREMENTS • Demonstrable professional experience in filmmaking, cinematography, video production, directing, editing, producing or a closely related discipline. • Strong understanding of cameras, lighting, sound capture, production workflows and post-production. • Evidence of completed productions or a credible professional portfolio. • Ability to plan and manage projects, people, schedules, budgets and deliverables. • Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving and decision-making skills. • Commercial awareness and the ability to convert production capacity into paying work. • Ability to work physically from Studio Shubz in Uyo and participate in location productions when required. • High standards of professionalism, accountability, documentation and client service. • Ability to work across commercial productions and Studio Shubz original projects. PREFERRED ATTRIBUTES • Experience managing a creative team or production department. • Existing relationships within the Nigerian film, media, advertising, wedding or entertainment industries. • Experience developing production budgets, treatments, proposals and schedules. • Familiarity with editing, colour grading, motion graphics, production sound or livestream systems. • Interest in developing African stories, creative talent and commercially viable media properties. SELECTION PROCESS Applicants who meet the initial requirements will complete a structured Video / Film practical assessment. The assessment includes reviewing a selected Studio Shubz production sequence and responding to department-specific creative, technical and operational questions. Successful applicants will proceed from Practical Assessment to Screening. No subscription, social-media like or public comment is required. HOW TO APPLY All applications must be completed through the official Studio Shubz recruitment page: https://shubz.org/staff-apply/ Applications submitted through email, direct messages or informal channels will not replace the official application. Studio Shubz — Where Vision Finds Voice.

review_candidates.title: Strategic Growth, Investment & Partnerships Volunteer
review_candidates.description: About MaxOhr Technologies MaxOhr Technologies is an innovation-driven technology company focused on solving real-world problems through hardware engineering, electronics, product development, refabrication engineering, and practical innovation. We believe technology should not merely be repaired or replaced—it can often be reimagined, improved, and given new possibilities. Our approach to Refabrication Engineering involves reconstructing, redesigning, modifying, and improving existing devices and systems to unlock capabilities beyond their original design. We combine engineering creativity with practical resourcefulness to turn ideas, existing technology, and sometimes discarded components into useful solutions. Our Services 1. Expert Electronics & Gadget Repair, Refurbishment and Maintenance: Smartphone, laptop and accessory repairs Headset, headphone and earbud repairs Smartwatch and wearable-device repairs Powerbank and portable-power repairs Solar generator and inverter-related solutions Electronics diagnostics and fault finding Device refurbishment and restoration Hardware modification and upgrades 2. Innovation Engineering & Fabrication: Electronics prototyping and product development Refabrication engineering solutions 3. Hardware technology training and practical electronics education Beyond conventional repairs, we focus on identifying the root cause of a problem, restoring devices professionally, and where possible, improving their functionality and usability. Our Innovation & Product Development Our innovation work explores practical solutions across consumer electronics, smart devices, hardware engineering, energy technology, and sustainable technology. Some of our projects include: The MaxOhr Pen A multifunctional electronic pen, featuring Illumination for brighter study experience in dark and dim environments, Bluetooth functionality with enhanced sound and full bass audio output, touchscreen stylus, rechargeable through a Type-C charging interface, and yet functions as a regular writing pen with refillable ink catridge. About the Volunteer Opportunity MaxOhr Technologies is entering its next phase of growth and is seeking strategic, passionate, and well-connected individuals who are willing to volunteer their time, expertise, network, and influence to help accelerate our growth and innovation projects. We are particularly interested in individuals who can help us with: Identifying funding and investment opportunities Connecting MaxOhr with potential investors, grant providers, accelerators, and funding organisations Developing strategic partnerships Connecting us with manufacturers, suppliers, technology companies, institutions, and potential clients Providing business, technical, commercial, or strategic mentorship Opening doors to relevant networks and opportunities Advising on scaling our products, services, and operations Supporting the commercialisation of our innovations Helping position MaxOhr for local, African, and eventually global opportunities This is a remote volunteer position, and there is no fixed requirement to relocate or work from an office. We are looking for people who genuinely believe in what we are building and are willing to contribute according to their capacity, expertise, network, and influence. Founding Member Opportunity Exceptional volunteers who demonstrate strong alignment with MaxOhr Technologies' vision, meaningful contribution, commitment, and strategic value may be considered for membership of the MaxOhr Innovation Board (MIB) as a Founding Member. Founding membership is not automatic and will be based on mutual alignment, contribution, commitment, expertise, network, and the individual's potential role in MaxOhr's growth. Who We Are Looking For You may be a good fit if you are: An investor or investment professional Grant/funding specialist Business development professional Entrepreneur or experienced founder Corporate or strategic partnerships professional Technology or engineering professional Industry expert or mentor Business strategist Someone with strong access to relevant business, investment, technology, or institutional networks Or simply someone who believes strongly in our vision and can meaningfully help us open the right doors You do not necessarily need to be an engineer. What matters most is your ability and willingness to contribute strategically. What You Can Expect This is a volunteer opportunity, so there is no guaranteed salary or fixed financial compensation attached to the role. However, successful volunteers will have the opportunity to: Work closely with the founder and innovation team Contribute to the growth of an emerging technology company Help bring practical hardware innovations closer to market Build meaningful relationships within the technology and investment ecosystem Potentially become a Founding Member of the MaxOhr Innovation Board Play a meaningful role in shaping the next phase of MaxOhr Technologies Our Vision We envision MaxOhr Technologies becoming a recognized African technology company developing innovative, practical, affordable, and sustainable hardware and energy solutions for real-world problems. If you have the resources, expertise, connections, experience, or simply the willingness to help us get there, we would love to hear from you. Join us in taking MaxOhr Technologies from promising ideas and working prototypes to scalable products, stronger services, strategic partnerships, and greater impact. To learn more about us, you are welcome to explore our website: https://www.maxohrtech.com.ng Also, I have documented our journey through a recently concluded series of 12 profoundly written and inspiring episodes called “The Journey of MaxOhr”; a personal account of my journey into innovation, beginning from when I was just 2–3 years old. You’re warmly invited to journey with me: https://www.maxohrtech.com.ng/blog/the-journey-of-maxohr/ I’d genuinely love to hear your thoughts as you read.
